CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_invitations (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, email VARCHAR(190) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, token_hash CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL UNIQUE, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', expires BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, accepted_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, accepted_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX (supplier_id,status), INDEX (expires))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_member_roles (supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'operator', updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id,user_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_print_specs (supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, category VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, print_width_mm INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, print_height_mm INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, target_dpi INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, bleed_mm INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL, approved TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, confirmed_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (supplier_id,category))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_pack_approvals (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, review_digest CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL, approved_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, approved_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '')

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_qc_evidence (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, line_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, upload_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, INDEX (order_id,line_id), INDEX (supplier_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_qc_reviews (order_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, placement TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, colour TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, finish TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reviewed_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, reviewed_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, revision INT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fulfillment_issues (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY, order_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, supplier_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, kind VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', message VARCHAR(1200) NOT NULL, resolution VARCHAR(1200) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, resolved_by VARCHAR(64) NULL, resolved_at VARCHAR(40) NULL, INDEX (order_id,status), INDEX (supplier_id,status))
